description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Dissanayaka Mudiyanselage Sarath Dissanayaka as a member of the Mahawa P/S. Elected Mr. Atula Priyantha Bellana as Vice Chairman of the Palindanuwara P/S. Vacated the office of member of the Bandarawela P/S by Mr.Sachchidanandan Suren Kanna
